name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-19 CRITICAL CRUD PERSISTENCE & MULTI-COMPANY SCOPE FIX: CRUD saves were applied to the WRONG company and then realistically wiped by the next sync — (a) upsert deltas resolved company scope with `companyId ?? rec.company_id`, so the SUBMISSION-TIME active scope always won and re-homed an existing record to whatever company the user was currently viewing (a Global-View save also blocked/scoped wrong), and deletes looked up the removed row in the NEXT map (the record was already gone, so scope fell through to the fallback and soft-deleted under the wrong company), (b) a direct-MySQL delta (upsert/delete into the normalized tables) racing an incremental snapshot/poll/Global-View re-fetch got OVERWRITTEN by the pre-write server state — 'added an item/customer/supplier, it vanished on the next background sync', (c) several delete handlers (expenses/suppliers/customers/purchase_orders/tax_rules/flash_sales/stories/disputes/product_returns/chat_conversations/installment_plans in api_entities, and stores in api.php) soft-deleted by id ONLY with no company_id scoping — two companies that happened to share a numeric id could delete each other's rows (chat_conversations/installment_plans were even HARD deletes), (d) after a company/branch/store switch the panels kept editing the PREVIOUS scope's in-flight form state (editingUser, editingItem, stock modal) — a save would re-home the record across companies. Fixes: (1) per-record scope resolution at submission time (`rec.company_id ?? rec.companyId ?? activeScope` for upserts, PREV map lookup for deletes) + saveAllData company fallback now getActiveCompanyScope() instead of companies[0].id + BAD_SCOPE now rejects '0' (Header company select emits the string '0' for index 0 in global view, which used to mint a destructive snapshot); (2) directDeltaGuards — in-flight delta batches pin the LOCAL next array for that key until all upsert/delete ops settle, and protectDirtyCollections/applyData overlay that snapshot (Fix 2); (3) backend company-scoped deletes + audit trails for every entity (api_entities tcV2ScopedDelete + api.php v2_delete_store company_id in the WHERE clause); (4) window `companyScopeChanged` event dispatched from Header/Settings/impersonate/return-to-root/demo-switch so MasterData/ManageUsers/stock-modal drop stale editing state on scope switch. Acceptance: deploy head commit -> hard refresh -> add customer/supplier/item -> verify it shows under the right company after a cross-device poll (no vanish) -> delete rows -> SELECT * FROM <table> WHERE company_id=<id> confirms scope -> switch company while a modal is stale -> new company's records untouched.
